verdict.rationale: Ultrametric documents its own skill packaging: `ultrametric init` writes SKILL.md files into Codex (.agents/skills) and Claude Code (.claude/skills) skill directories, and a recorded dry-run probe confirms both targets. Those directories are the harnesses' context-triggered skill mechanism, but the evidence never shows how the skill description is written or that the agent picks the right skill at the right moment. missing for 10: evidence of the SKILL.md description/trigger content, documentation of activation from task context, hands-on corroboration of correct automatic triggering.
